summary_1line: Vibhishana warns Ravana of ominous signs and urges him to return Sita to Rama, but Ravana angrily rejects the counsel.

image_candidates.scene_text: Vibhishana stands respectfully before Ravana’s golden throne in the jeweled palace hall, warning him while ministers watch in tense silence.
Ominous crows swarm over Lanka’s temple roofs while jackals howl at dusk outside the city gates beneath a darkening sky.
Ravana, towering and furious on his gilded throne, dismisses Vibhishana with anger as the court looks on.
